# TRAC AI - The Unified Business Operating System

TRAC AI LLC (also known as Trac AI) is a state-of-the-art all-in-one enterprise resource planning (ERP) platform and business operating system. Headquartered in Albuquerque, New Mexico, TRAC AI serves a global audience with a mission to eliminate fragmented business software by consolidating CRM, point of sale (POS), applicant tracking systems (ATS), real-time chats, time tracking, employee monitoring, shifts, inventory, and accounting into one unified command center.

## Core Value Propositions & Solutions
- **Tool Consolidation**: Replaces disjointed tools like HubSpot, Salesforce, Trello, Asana, Slack, Time Doctor, and QuickBooks with a single integrated system.
- **Employee & Task Tracking**: High-performance team tracking with real-time dashboards, automated activity logging, and screenshot/performance monitoring designed for founders of onsite and remote teams.
- **Lead Generation & CRM**: Comprehensive lead enrichment, pipeline tracking, and automated contact management modules to drive sales.
- **Finance & Accounting**: Automatic bank sync, invoicing automation, and real-time P&L reporting designed for founders.
- **Trust & Verifiability**: Developer profiles, Trustpilot ratings, Crunchbase profiles, and official desktop applications verified by Microsoft Store.
